body: More and more people are picking up binoculars and heading to parks to watch birds, a hobby that used to seem old-fashioned.
越来越多的人拿起望远镜走进公园观鸟，这个曾被认为'过时'的爱好正在翻红。
Fans say birdwatching forces you to slow down, listen carefully and notice small changes in nature around you.
爱好者说，观鸟会逼你慢下来、仔细听，去留意身边自然界的细微变化。
You need almost nothing to start: a quiet morning, a bit of patience, and curiosity about the songs above your head.
入门几乎零门槛：一个安静的早晨、一点耐心，加上对头顶鸟鸣的好奇心就够了。
On hot summer nights, many of us toss and turn because our body needs to cool down slightly before it can fall asleep.
炎热的夏夜里我们翻来覆去，因为身体需要先稍微降温才能入睡。
Experts suggest simple tricks: take a warm shower before bed, keep curtains closed in the day, and use light cotton sheets.
专家给出简单妙招：睡前洗个温水澡、白天拉上窗帘、换轻薄的纯棉床单。
A regular sleep routine matters even more in a heatwave, so try to go to bed at the same time every night.
热浪天里规律作息更重要，尽量每天同一时间上床睡觉。

articles.zh: 球员罚点球时脑子里在想啥
body: When a footballer steps up to take a penalty, millions watch — and the real battle happens inside the player's head.
当球员站上点球点，数百万人在看——而真正的较量发生在他的大脑里。
Sports scientists find that top players train their minds like muscles, using breathing and routines to stay calm under pressure.
运动科学家发现，顶级球员像练肌肉一样训练大脑，用呼吸法和固定流程在压力下保持冷静。
The same tricks work off the pitch too: before an interview or a big talk, slow breathing helps anyone perform better.
这些技巧场外同样管用：面试或重要发言前，放慢呼吸能让任何人发挥更好。

articles.en: Does Planning the Perfect Summer Cause Problems?
body: Social media is full of picture-perfect holidays, and many people feel their own summer must look just as amazing.
社交媒体上满是完美假期照，很多人觉得自己的夏天也必须同样精彩。
But chasing a perfect plan often brings stress: overpacked schedules leave no room for rest or happy accidents.
但追求完美计划常带来压力：排得太满的行程，容不下休息和惊喜。
Researchers say the best memories usually come from simple, unplanned moments — an evening walk or an ice cream by the road.
研究者说，最好的回忆往往来自简单、没计划的时刻——一次傍晚散步，或路边一支冰淇淋。
Breathing keeps us alive, but doing it slowly and on purpose can also calm a racing mind within minutes.
呼吸维持生命，但有意识地放慢呼吸，几分钟内就能安抚焦躁的大脑。
One popular method is 'box breathing': breathe in for four counts, hold for four, breathe out for four, and hold again.
流行的'方块呼吸法'：吸气4拍、屏住4拍、呼气4拍、再屏住4拍。
Unlike apps or gym gear, breathwork is free and always with you — a pocket tool for stressful days.
和APP、健身装备不同，呼吸练习免费又随身——是压力大时的'口袋工具'。
